data.value: The total shown includes the rental for the whole period, VAT and the daily contribution owed to the State. The extras you choose (additional driver, child seat, franchise waiver, delivery) are added to it and the total is recalculated before payment.

data.name: Terms.Description
data.value: Rental terms and conditions: booking, drivers and documents, price and payment, deposit, cancellation, use of the car.

data.name: Terms.Draft
data.value: Provisional version: these terms are being written with our lawyer and will be completed before online booking opens. Only the contract signed when you pick up the car is binding.
data.comment: TODO(spec): rental terms to be written with the agency's lawyer (SPEC §14).

data.name: Terms.Section1.Text
data.value: An online booking is a request: an agent validates it after checking the availability and the documents, usually within 2 business hours. It is only binding once the confirmation is sent by e-mail.

data.name: Terms.Section2.Text
data.value: Each driver shows an identity document (national ID card for Tunisians, passport otherwise) and a driving licence valid until the return date, with an international driving permit if the licence is not written in Latin characters. Age and licence seniority requirements are given in the FAQ.

data.name: Terms.Section3.Text
data.value: Prices are in Tunisian dinars, VAT and daily contribution included, and the quote is frozen at booking. The guaranteed amount is held on the card with the request and charged when the agent validates it.
data.comment: TODO(spec): guarantee policy (deposit or full amount) to be set with the agency.

data.name: Terms.Section4.Text
data.value: A deposit is taken when you pick up the car and returned when you bring it back, minus justified charges. The franchise waiver lowers it and your share in case of damage.

data.name: Terms.Section5.Text
data.value: Cancellation terms and fees, and the delay after which a rental not picked up counts as a no-show, will be set out here.
data.comment: TODO(spec): cancellation and no-show policy of the agency.

data.name: Terms.Section6.Text
data.value: Fuel, mileage, late return and the ban on leaving Tunisian territory: the detailed rules will be set out here and in the contract.

data.name: Terms.Section7.Text
data.value: Fines incurred during the rental are paid by the driver. In case of accident or damage, tell the agency at once: a report is drawn up.

data.name: Terms.Section8.Text
data.value: The rental contract signed when you pick up the car is binding. The applicable law and the settlement of disputes will be set out here.
